run_dashboard: run the streamlit lightweight dashboard to browse and analyze meta experiment data directories
scan_base_directory: scan a base directory path to discover and list all meta experiment subdirectories
initialize_session_state: initialize the streamlit session state with default values for the meta experiment dashboard
handle_meta_exp_change: handle user selection changes when switching between different meta experiments in the dashboard
display_file_content: display the content of a selected file with configurable preview lines and view mode options
